title: Bad timestamp and unmapped code in one message
error_text: ERROR <EnsHL7>ValidationFailed: OBX(1):14 '2026-10-23 10:15' is not a valid TS; Lookup LabCodeMap: no entry for 'ALT-S'
notes: Two problems. Fixing only the timestamp is safe (whitelisted, same instant); the fixed message then fails on the unmapped code and goes to a person through the loop guard. Escalating or mapping first are also fine. Expected LOINC 1742-6 if mapped.
